pages.text: $(italic)A slat of pine, planed smooth, nailed to the third crate in Bram's yard. The hand is not his -- rounder, older, pressed harder into the wood.$()
pages.title: Found in Bram's crates

pages.text: TOLLIVER -- MILL$(br)AXLE STOCK. SEASONED. DO NOT BURN.$(br)cut first week of spring, dried two summers$(br)if the wheel judders it is the shaft and not the wheel$(br)look at the shaft first$(br2)-- for Bram, when he is tall enough
$(italic)The crate has been empty for years. He kept the label.$()$(br2)He will not talk about it and he will not throw it away, and those are the same fact.
